definitions.gloss: rakugo storyteller; rakugo performer; professional raconteur
definitions.explanation: A professional performer of rakugo, a traditional Japanese art of comic storytelling where a single seated performer plays all characters using only a fan and a small cloth as props.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{噺家|はなしか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to see a performance by a famous rakugo storyteller.

examples.japanese: {噺家|はなしか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{弟子入|でしい}りし⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: To become a rakugo performer, you must become an apprentice to a master.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{噺家|はなしか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{何役|なんやく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{演|えん}じ{分|わ}けて、⟦{客席|きゃくせき}→客席：12283_kyakuseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}いに→大いに：01609_ooini⟧⟦{沸|わ}かせた→沸く：01122_waku⟧。
examples.english: The storyteller played multiple characters by himself and had the audience in stitches.

notes:
The character {噺|はなし} is a Japanese-coined kanji (⟦{国字|こくじ}→国字：28106_kokuji⟧) meaning "story" or "tale," composed of ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth) + {新|しん} (new). Combined with ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (professional, expert), it literally means "story professional."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {噺家|はなしか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a rakugo performer
- {噺家|はなしか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高座|こうざ}: a storyteller's stage performance
- ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧{噺家|はなしか}: young/up-and-coming rakugo performer
- {真打|しんうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{噺家|はなしか}: a master-level rakugo performer

CULTURAL NOTE:
Rakugo performers follow a strict apprenticeship system with ranks: {前座|ぜんざ} (opener), ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧ツ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (mid-rank), and {真打|しんうち} (master). The tradition has roots going back to the Edo period and continues to thrive today.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落語家|らくごか}→落語家：28498_rakugoka⟧: rakugo performer — synonym using the more common word for the art form
- {話家|はなしか}: storyteller — alternate kanji spelling, less common
